errors.not_found: This resource does not exist, or you cannot see it.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.insufficient_scope: This access token lacks the {{scope}} permission.
errors.auth_not_configured: This server has no sign-in configured, so it cannot accept access tokens.
errors.missing_token: Sign in to continue: the request carries no access token.
errors.invalid_token: The access token is not valid. Sign in again.
errors.token_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.admin_reauth_required: For your security, administration needs a recent sign-in. Sign in again to continue.
errors.idp_unavailable: The sign-in service cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.missing_json_content_type: The request body must be JSON (Content-Type: application/json).
errors.invalid_json: The request body is not valid JSON: {{reason}}
errors.invalid_body: The request body is not what this operation expects: {{reason}}
errors.invalid_query: The query string is not what this operation expects: {{reason}}
errors.idempotency_key_invalid: The Idempotency-Key must be 1 to {{max}} visible ASCII characters.
errors.idempotency_key_reused: This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request.
errors.idempotency_key_in_flight: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed.
errors.idempotency_outcome_unknown: The first request with this Idempotency-Key ended without a stored answer: it may have taken effect. It is not done again. Check whether it took effect, then use a new key if it did not.
errors.request_timed_out: The request took longer than the server allows and was stopped. It may have taken effect: check, then retry with a new Idempotency-Key if it did not.
errors.idempotency_secret_shown_once: This request was already done with this Idempotency-Key. Its secret is shown only once and was not kept, so it cannot be shown again.
errors.idempotency_body_too_large: The request body is too large to be used with an Idempotency-Key.
errors.database_unavailable: The database is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than the limit of {{limit}} bytes.
errors.upload_mismatch: The uploaded file does not match what was expected. Upload it again.
errors.upload_failed: Reading the upload failed. Try again.
errors.too_many_streams: You have too many live update connections open. Close some tabs or windows and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.mailbox_unsupported: Connecting this kind of mailbox is not available on this instance.
